title: AgtMLS analysis finding
description: One finding emitted by a conformant analyzer. Every finding carries a stable rule identifier: suppressions, SARIF export and cross-implementation comparison all key on the rule, never on the prose message.

file.description: Path, POSIX-separated, relative to the audited root where possible.

line.description: 1-indexed SOURCE line. Normalised-scope rules match a flattened document but must report a real source line (spec 4.3).

suppressed_by.description: Digest-keyed suppression entry that silenced this finding, when reporting suppressed findings.
